recap.text: Tserendolgor is a level twenty-seven Dog Soldier from Earth who took the Crisper Class. She uses a magical flamethrower and a helmet with holes for her ears. A cat calls her he and accuses her of stealing a kill, but she holds the choke point beside the cat's party.

Tserendolgor crawls inside her bubble wall to find a slot for a final gem when a giant empty eye socket appears and screams. The world heats up and saferoom doorknobs melt. A flyer goes out to place the last crystal and pop the bubble while the others take the stairs. A platinum quest box pays out a flamethrower upgrade and a tome of Heal Party.

Tserendolgor, ranked 54, uses ultraviolet on her flamethrower to kill fast vampire drillbeaks. Now ranked 38 and called Ren, she rides to a castle with a level-20 blob shaped like a lumpy meatball that giggles and has one tooth. The blob wins Best in Show, and Princess Donut calls Ren an experience hog and a cheater. Carl laughs until he cries.

Tserendolgor is a former runway model from Mongolia who wears a paw print necklace. She uses a Mongolian Death Worm totem that eats her tank, Chuluuna, after a spell swap. Tserendolgor gives Carl her gear and a level one pet before using a wrist bracer to collapse the Capitol building on herself.

beats.headline: A name nobody on the crawl can pronounce
beats.text: Subject is from Earth, a level twenty-seven Dog Soldier who took the Crisper Class, which in practice means a magical flamethrower and a helmet with holes cut for the ears. Nobody has worked out how to pronounce her name. A certain cat has already called her 'he' and accused her of hogging a kill she did not steal, over a race the cat dislikes on sight, and she holds the choke point beside that cat's party regardless, which is a distinction the cat never quite grasps.
beats.gist: Tserendolgor is a level twenty-seven Dog Soldier with a magical flamethrower and a holey helmet.

beats.headline: A hundred and sixty inside, and an eye socket
beats.text: Crawler Tserendolgor is crawling along the inside of her bubble wall, looking for the slot for the final gem, when a giant empty eye socket appears on the other side. It calls her Orthrus and starts screaming, then pounding on the wall. Her world is heating up; the mountain walls are beginning to glow, and in the same bubble a saferoom door is glowing red. She posts to the main chat. There are 160 of them in there and they have not lost a person yet. They were almost done.
beats.gist: Tserendolgor searches her bubble wall for a gem slot when a screaming eye socket appears.

beats.headline: Bubble 18, after the god
beats.text: Bubble 18, per Crawler Tserendolgor's messages. While Emberus was outside, the interior doorknobs in their saferooms were literally melting. Now he is gone, the world is too hot and everything has melted, and one of them who can fly is going out to put the last crystal in place and pop the bubble. The rest will take the stairs straight after. The platinum quest box paid out an upgrade to her flamethrower and a tome of Heal Party to a man in her group. Everyone, she reports, is getting good stuff.
beats.gist: Crawler Tserendolgor reports the interior doorknobs melted and a flyer pops Bubble 18.

beats.headline: Ranked fifty-four, with ultraviolet
beats.text: Crawler Tserendolgor, some two hundred kilometres away, reports that the drillbeaks in her area disappeared almost overnight and came back as vampires, twice as strong and very fast. She believes a touch does not infect, only a severe injury. Ultraviolet cast on her flamethrower kills them quickly, and she is staying indoors in this rain. She is ranked 54, trying to reach the top 50 for the invitation. Princess Donut reopens the matter of stolen experience from three floors ago.
beats.gist: Tserendolgor reports drillbeaks became fast, strong vampires, but ultraviolet on her flamethrower kills them quickly.

beats.headline: A pet like a lumpy meatball
beats.text: Crawler Tserendolgor, ranked 38 and now called Ren by everyone who cannot pronounce the rest, rides to the castle in the fifth wagon with her plus-one. Following on foot: her pet show entry, a level-20 blob she received on this floor for attending CrawlCon. It is as tall as Carl, shaped like a lumpy meatball, has one tooth and a mouth that could swallow a man, giggles as it walks, and tanks enormous damage. People love it.
beats.gist: Ren, ranked 38, rides to the castle with a giggling, meatball-shaped level-20 blob from CrawlCon.

beats.headline: Best in show
beats.text: Pet Show Champion. Best in Show. It goes to her giggling meatball of a pet, and the trophy mark appears over Tserendolgor's head in the field of the dead, just after she has come to stand beside Carl and Princess Donut has jumped onto her shoulder in solidarity. Princess Donut poofs out entirely, calls her an experience hog and a cheater, and retreats to Carl's shoulder, hissing. Carl laughs until he cries.
beats.gist: Tserendolgor wins Best in Show for her giggling meatball of a pet.

beats.headline: A reference, of sorts
beats.text: Subject is the only crawler Carl can find who knows the three newcomers directly, and she supplies what she has. She keeps Paz in her chat. Paz and Anton are cousins, protective of the nun. Their party was bigger before a rough sixth floor. They are friends with Osvaldo's group without sharing his guild. Anton reportedly killed two members of his own group on the first or second floor after they tried to kill the nun. Paz has a directional self-destruct spell. Her recommendation: do not fight them. Crawler Donut notes that of course the cheater lady knows them.
beats.gist: Tserendolgor is the only crawler who knows the three newcomers and supplies Carl with information.

beats.headline: Proposed for the guild
beats.text: Subject's party is under discussion for guild membership; Imani and the subject have been talking, and other guilds want her team as well. Background, as it circulates in chat: born in Mongolia, a runway model in Paris through her teens and twenties, badly injured by a jealous ex-boyfriend, back in Mongolia shortly before the collapse. The nearest thing the crawl has to a pre-collapse celebrity. She wears a necklace with a paw print on it. Crawler Donut asks why a supermodel would turn into a dog, and then votes no on behalf of five.
beats.gist: Imani and Tserendolgor discuss guild membership while other guilds want her team.

beats.headline: The sniper on the hill
beats.text: Subject's group tried what nearly everybody tried: kill the deckmaster before the fight begins. She posted a long-range man with an old-school sling and a targeting spell on a hill overlooking the frozen opponent. The moment combat started, the spell failed and the opponent moved a meter to the left, spoiling the shot. He killed it anyway, a minute on. Elsewhere, traps ringed around frozen deckmasters simply vanished at the start, and crawlers standing inside the ring were knocked unconscious.
beats.gist: Ren posted a man with a sling and targeting spell on a hill to kill the deckmaster.

beats.headline: No key for her squad
beats.text: Keymaster report, eighth floor. Subject did not obtain her key. Two members of her squad are dead. If she wishes to reach the ninth floor, she must now take a key from a team that has one. She is not alone in this: from the stories coming in, most teams facing the keymaster have come away without one, which is how the final phase has been set up.
beats.gist: Tserendolgor did not obtain a key, and two squad members are dead.

beats.headline: It's us, Carl
beats.text: Chat log. Carl, in general chat, asks anyone in Cuba to hold the exit in the Capitol building: Quan Ch has both keys and is heading for one of the two doors. A short pause, then subject: it is her squad at the Capitol. She is sorry she did not say anything sooner. They will be ready. Donut hisses at the message. Carl opens a new chat with her and Imani and tells them to delay him.
beats.gist: Carl asks the Cuba chat to hold the Capitol building exit; Tserendolgor responds and Donut hisses.

beats.headline: Her own worm takes Chuluuna
beats.text: Combat log, the Capitol. Subject summons her largest totem, Basquiat the Mongolian Death Worm, and puts Temporary Immortality on it. Quan's Toss-Up swaps three of his totems for two of hers, and the worm is his. It eats his old totems, then her tank, Chuluuna, the husband of her squadmate Khulan, while she calls his name. Quan dies, and Donut is credited with the kill, so both keys go to the cat. Then the door starts to crumble.
beats.gist: Tserendolgor summons Basquiat the Mongolian Death Worm and gives it Temporary Immortality.

beats.headline: She will not fight for the last key
beats.text: One key is left, and either she fights the cat or she does not. Subject sits down and unsnaps her flamethrower. Velma; she did not name it. She gives Carl her gear, Eye in the Sky scrolls included. She kills her pet with the Knife of Frozen Tears, so it resets to level one, and hands it over in a carrier. She shows Carl the bracer on her wrist. She confesses to Donut that she cheated at the pet show. Then Khulan's gear, and every card but her totems.
beats.gist: Tserendolgor gives Carl her gear, Eye in the Sky scrolls, and Khulan's gear.

beats.headline: The bracer, and the dome
beats.text: Crawler Tserendolgor tells Crawler Carl to get himself clear of the building, because her magical wrist bracer is about to bring it down. Her last message to the chat says goodbye, notes that at least nobody will butcher the pronunciation of her name any more, and asks everyone to make them all pay. The dome folds in on itself like a controlled demolition, barely noticeable in a burning city. Princess Donut's reply arrives in capitals, asking what she is doing. She never sees it. Her name moves to the deceased crawlers folder.
beats.gist: Tserendolgor tells Carl to leave the building before her magical wrist bracer brings it down.
